SELECT email,id,user_name,phone,login_time,vip,reg_time,total_account,code_account,code_total,login_ip,channelCode from member_info where id = #{userid}
SELECT fun_getaddress(login_ip) ipaddress from member_info where id = #{userid}
select SUM(money) from member_pay_jour_history where STATUS = '1' and member_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(recharge_money),0) rechargemoney from member_recharge_log where type = '1' and status = '3' and member_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sub_money),0) submoney from member_pay_jour where status='1' and member_id = #{userid} and pay_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(money),0) p_money from pay_agent_recharge_log where member_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(income),0) rg_income FROM log_money${tableLast} where type='-1' and user_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(income),0) zs_income FROM log_money${tableLast} where type in ('5','7','8','9','12','13','14') and user_id = #{userid}
select COUNT(1) w_count from member_withdraw_log where status in ('3','6') and member_id = #{userid}
select IFNULL(SUM(withdraw_money),0) w_sum from member_withdraw_log where STATUS in ('0','1','3','4','6') and member_id = #{userid}

(select count(1) gcount FROM member_game_data${tableLast} WHERE agent in ('10000','80000') and (cell_score - profit)/cell_score > 1 and 1.04 > (cell_score - profit)/cell_score and account = #{userid})
select count(1) gtcount FROM member_game_data${tableLast} WHERE agent in ('10000','80000') and account = #{userid}

select p.name as class_twoname,convert(sum(g.cell_score),decimal(10,2)) touZhu,convert(sum(g.profit),decimal(10,2)) yingLi FROM member_game_data${tableLast} g LEFT JOIN game_platform p on g.platform_id = p.id WHERE account = #{userid} GROUP BY g.platform_id

select ifnull((count(*)),0) number,channelCode as channelcode,email,inviter_code as inviterCode from member_info
and inviter_code = #{inviterCode}
and channelCode = #{channelcode}
and email like concat('%', #{email}, '%')
AND reg_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{params.beginTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND reg_time <= STR_TO_DATE(#{params.endTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and reg_time >= '${downLoadDate[0]}' and reg_time <= '${downLoadDate[1]}'
GROUP BY email,channelCode
